prompt:
Two-line cosmo change, shipped together so no intermediate state breaks eval: (1) update the the-valley flake input pin to current main (nix flake lock --update-input the-valley); (2) in hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix, set the valley integrator's new instance-project option to "qinling" — read the option's exact name and type from the pinned the-valley's nix/valley-host.nix (grep instance in the integrator options) rather than guessing; qinling is the gunk-dev instance repository whose served bare repo carries the group's policy floor. Match the surrounding option style; one terse comment: the floor is read from this repo's integrated tip.

If an automated "chore: update the-valley" PR appears while you work, rebase onto or close-and-supersede it — one PR should land both halves. Verify: nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --no-link in the FOREGROUND; open the PR FIRST with verification-in-progress, comment the pasted result. Normal PR flow; no AI mentions; no Co-Authored-By trailers naming Claude or Anthropic.
